items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Nichole Barclay and Eddie Barclay -- it was Nichole that came over here to recruit the musicians that are to appear at this Festival of Jazz.

ctx.x: remember just the one time Bechet came back, Sidney Bechet is the only man that ever gave me money just because I'm Big Chief. He had just come home from Paris and asked me to come over to his hotel. So I went over to his hotel and there he was sitting on the bed, he's got a pile of bread, a lot of money there, counting his bread. So he came to like two $100 bills, gave me $200, "Here, Chief, this is for you need that." you." I said, "Come on, Sidney, that's your bread. "If you don't take it I'm going to throw it…

To go back to the story of how I got to Paris. Nichole Barclay and Eddie Barclay -- it was Nichole that came over here to recruit the musicians that are to appear at this Festival of Jazz. So there was Charlie Parker, Sidney Bechet, Hot Lips Page, some of the boppers that were there, I'll think of them later. I'm recounting the circumstances of how I got to Paris. They got everybody that they wanted to get to appear at the festival in Paris, except one.
